excerpt: New tools for content creators Communication is evolving by leaps and bounds. Journalists specialised in digital content creation are very necessary. For this reason, constant updating of the tools, methodologies and communication strategies of journalism is essential. This Master in Digital and Data Journalism provides journalists with the tools to become digital content creators, the necessary technological training and the learning of new narratives applied to 360º communication. The new ways of consuming information generate needs in the professional market that requires experts in immersive journalism, planning and development of content for digital media, data visualisation and web analytics. All these skills are what the traditional media require in their daily task of adapting their formats to what is transversal to all: the digital world. Our syllabus is constantly updated and is taught by the best professionals in the sector. In addition to this, the Faculty of Communication and Arts has signed a collaboration agreement with the newspaper 20minutos, a newspaper belonging to the Henneo group, a leader in digital information readership. This collaboration guarantees training that is very close to the professional world and to the needs of new narratives that journalism requires today. 20minutos is Spain's leading general information newspaper, belonging to the Henneo group, which has highly prestigious titles such as El Heraldo de Aragón, La Información and Cinemanía, as well as television production companies with more than 3,500 hours of production per year.
